languages.name: Lua
languages.description: A lightweight, embeddable scripting language designed around a small core and simple semantics.

categories.name: Core Language
categories.description: Fundamental Lua syntax and language constructs.

entries.title: local
entries.summary: Declare a variable with local scope.
entries.definition: The local keyword declares a variable whose scope is limited to the current block or function.
entries.mental_model: Create a name that belongs only to the current neighborhood of code rather than the entire program.
entries.gotchas: Forgetting local can cause a variable to become global.
entries.notes: Local variables are generally preferred unless global state is intentionally required.

examples.title: Basic local variable
examples.explanation: Creates a local variable named bat and prints its value.

examples.title: Local number
examples.explanation: Stores a numeric value in a local variable.

categories.name: Standard Library
categories.description: Built-in Lua libraries and their functions.

packages.name: table
packages.description: The table library provides operations for inserting, removing, sorting, concatenating, and otherwise working with sequence-like tables.

entries.title: table.insert()
entries.summary: Insert a value into a table.
entries.definition: Inserts a value into a sequence-like table, either at the end or at a specified position.
entries.mental_model: Take an existing ordered table and push a new item into one of its slots.
entries.gotchas: Inserting into the middle of a large sequence requires later elements to be shifted.

arguments.name: list
arguments.description: The table that will receive the new value.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.description: Optional position where the value should be inserted.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The value to insert into the table.

examples.title: Append a value
examples.explanation: With no position supplied, table.insert adds the value to the end of the sequence.

examples.title: Insert at a position
examples.code:
local keys = {
    "M1",
    "M3"
}

table.insert(keys, 2, "M2")

for index, key in ipairs(keys) do
    print(index, key)
end
examples.explanation: Inserts M2 into position 2, shifting the previous second element to the right.

entries.title: table.concat()
entries.summary: Join sequence values into a string.
entries.definition: Combines values from a sequence-like table into a single string.
entries.mental_model: Take several string fragments and stitch them together with an optional separator.
entries.return_value: A string containing the joined values.
entries.gotchas: The sequence values must be compatible with string concatenation.

arguments.name: list
arguments.description: Sequence containing the values to join.

examples.title: Build a sentence
examples.code:
local words = {
    "Trans",
    "Rights",
    "are",
    "Human",
    "Rights"
}

local message = table.concat(words, " ")

print(message)
examples.explanation: Joins every table element with a space between them.
